en.headline: New Capital Investment Entrant Scheme exceeds 5000 applications
en.dek: The Financial Services and the Treasury Bureau said applications as of end-October are expected to bring more than HK$150 billion in investment, with over 3000 already approved.
body: Applications under the New Capital Investment Entrant Scheme exceeded 5000 as of the end of October, according to the Financial Services and the Treasury Bureau.

The bureau said the scheme, launched in March 2024, is expected to attract more than HK$150 billion in investment to Hong Kong. Over 3000 applications had been verified as having completed the required investment and received formal approval.

Secretary for Financial Services and the Treasury Christopher Hui said at a forum that 10 percent of the investment goes to the Hong Kong Investment Corporation to support innovation and technology. The government has already introduced measures to optimise the scheme and plans further amendments, including relaxing the 20 percent cap on precious metals as qualifying investments and expanding the definition of funds to include perpetual funds.
Officials said the scheme continues to attract high-net-worth individuals and capital from around the world, contributing to the growth of family offices in the city.

zh.headline: 新資本投資者入境計劃申請突破5000宗
zh.dek: 財經事務及庫務局表示，至10月底申請料帶來超過1500億元投資，當中逾3000宗已獲正式批准。
body: 財經事務及庫務局表示，截至10月底，新資本投資者入境計劃接獲申請突破5000宗。
局方指，計劃自2024年3月實施以來，預計可為香港帶來超過1500億元投資額，當中超過3000宗申請已獲核實完成投資並得到正式批准。
財經事務及庫務局局長許正宇在論壇上表示，其中一成資金投放香港投資公司，用於支持創科發展。政府已落實一系列優化措施，並計劃提出修正案，包括放寬貴金屬作為合資格投資的20%上限，以及擴大基金定義以納入永續基金。
官員表示，計劃持續吸引環球高淨值人士及資本落戶香港，家族辦公室亦錄得強勁增長。
